dedupe_keys.name: ghs built r2018a landsat multitemporal built up grid

description: The European Commission Joint Research Centre publishes this R2018A Global Human Settlement Layer grid from Landsat imagery. It classifies built-up presence across the 1975, 1990, 2000 and 2014 epochs, with a global 30 m product and derived 250 m and 1 km layers. JRC provides tiled GeoTIFF and VRT access from its named product page without registration or charge. The page states European Commission reuse with source acknowledgement, subject to individual third-party notices. Settlement maps can be combined with roads, buildings or population estimates for historical exposure and urban-growth scenarios in infrastructure simulations. The grid does not establish the location, condition or capacity of particular assets, and a class change is not an annual construction date. JRC marks this release obsolete; its classes and processing may differ from current GHSL products. No raster was downloaded or inspected. The record preserves an explicitly versioned historical grid alongside the catalogue's newer GHSL record and the separate R2015B draft.
